ops.title: Phase 2 build brief — container-native hermes (Architecture B)
ops.body:
Synthesis of 5 understanding-recon passes (2026-07-16) for building container-native hermes. Cites are yclaw repo unless noted "upstream" (NousResearch/hermes-agent @ rev 551f00109de824f147e0826260f649b3fdc3f9e7).

## Image model — `container run`, NOT `container machine`
Architecture B runs hermes-agent as an OCI container via `container run` (apple/container gives it a micro-VM with a WRITABLE overlay rootfs). So: a plain entrypoint script, NO NixOS systemd boot, NO read-only-root preInit wrapper (that was E2's `container machine` path, `~/.yclaw/spike-container`/guest `/root/container-spike/mkImageRO`). Do NOT reuse machine.nix/machine-full.nix.

## 2a — OCI image (build on the hermes guest)
- Builder = the live hermes tart guest: nix 2.28.5, nix2container @ 76be9608 (`n2c.buildImage`), nixpkgs @ 6201e203, aarch64-linux, `/root/container-spike/flake.nix` has the reusable `n2c.buildImage { name; tag; copyToRoot; config; }` primitive. Export via `skopeo copy nix:<img.json> oci-archive:...` (or `container image load`). Guest disk: 19G avail — watch closure size (hermes closure ~1.7 GiB).
- Package: `patchedHermesAgent` (the patched flake input, hermes.nix:145-169 `applyPatches` + prPatch mechanism) + docker CLI + tailscale + sops + coreutils + the entrypoint. NO gvisor/dockerd in the image (nested exec goes to host socktainer, not an in-image daemon) — this is why 1b/gvisor is off the critical path.
- Upstream ALSO ships `services.hermes-agent.container.enable` mode (upstream nixosModules.nix:933-1007) BUT it bind-mounts the host `/nix/store` and runs `${dataDir}/current-package/bin/hermes gateway run` — NOT a portable image. Its `containerEntrypoint` (nixosModules.nix:87-189: GID/UID reconcile, first-boot apt/uv/node provisioning, privilege drop via setpriv/su) is a REFERENCE for our entrypoint's interactive-tool setup, not directly reusable.

## config.yaml (part of 2a/2b)
- Pipeline: `settings` (hermes.nix:332-551) → `builtins.toJSON` → upstream `configMergeScript` (python3+pyyaml deep-merge onto existing config.yaml, nix keys win, user keys survive) → `${stateDir}/.hermes/config.yaml`. stateDir=/var/lib/hermes → `/var/lib/hermes/.hermes/config.yaml`, HERMES_HOME=/var/lib/hermes/.hermes.
- For a fresh container state dir: `yaml.dump(json.load(settings.json))` ≡ merge-into-{}. Only need the deep-merge if the bind-mounted state carries prior user edits (mcp_servers etc.). NO secrets in settings (only `key_env` pointers naming CLIPROXY_API_KEY).

## 2b — secret entrypoint (replaces sops-nix + seedNodeConfig + renderHermesProxyEnv)
Stage from host `~/.yclaw/state/hosts/hermes/`: key.txt (age priv, 600), secrets.sops.yaml (600), + node.env (644) + agent-vault-token (600, minted live from metal `metal-mint-hermes-token`, format av_agt_*). Entrypoint:
1. `sops --decrypt` with `SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE=<age key>` against secrets.sops.yaml, extract the `hermes.env` block scalar → 2-line dotenv: `BLUEBUBBLES_PASSWORD` + `CLIPROXY_API_KEY` (TWO real secrets, not one). Working example of the pattern: `cliproxy_key_from_metal_bundle()` in scripts/lib/secrets.sh (~170).
2. Render agent-vault-proxy.env (600): `HTTPS_PROXY=http://<token>:hermes@metal:14322` + `HTTP_PROXY=...` (literal `:hermes@` is a fixed vault-hint, not a var). FATAL if token empty.
3. cat-append into `${stateDir}/.hermes/.env`, LAST WINS order: (1) hermesEnvFile static [hermes.nix:33-72] → (2) node.env [FQDN bluebubbles values] → (3) decrypted hermes/env → (4) agent-vault-proxy.env. python-dotenv keeps last dup.
- Keep the age key 0400, never bake secrets into the image, never dump env.
- tailscale/authkey is SEPARATE (feeds tailscaled via services.tailscale.authKeyFile, not the agent). node.env identity values from bootstrap.sh:135-140: BLUEBUBBLES_{ALLOWED_USERS,HOME_CHANNEL,SERVER_URL=https://bluebubbles.$DOMAIN,WEBHOOK_HOST=hermes.$DOMAIN} (FQDN required for TLS SNI + non-loopback webhook bind).

## 2c — sandbox chain
hermes-docker-proxy(patched, Phase 1a) + socktainer run on the HOST, supervised; agent container mounts ONLY the proxy socket (E1 structural isolation). DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/hermes-docker-proxy/docker.sock (matches hermesEnvFile default). BIND_ROOTS=agent stateDir. Nested code-exec sandboxes launch on a custom NON-NAT `container network create` net (E3: zero egress by construction).

## 2e — pf egress (THE KNIFE-EDGE, open design)
CRITICAL: host-pf.sh (host/host-pf.sh) is host-SELF-protection (blocks vmnet INBOUND to `self`), NOT egress-deny — fleet guest→internet NAT is deliberately OPEN. Do NOT mirror it verbatim for egress control. Need a NEW egress-deny anchor for the agent-container subnet: block fleet + host-tailnet-services + general internet, permit ONLY tailscale (control + DERP + WG port 41641). Justified because ALL real agent traffic routes through metal:14322 vault proxy over the tailnet (NO_PROXY=metal,bluebubbles,.ts.net). Tailscale DERP/control egress IPs need resolve-and-refresh in the sleep-loop (like host-pf.sh resolves fleet IPs live). install_pf_anchor <name> <rules> --wire-load-only --enable (pf.sh:28-77): child anchor com.apple/0XX.yclaw.container, targeted `pfctl -a` load, NEVER full reload. GET CODEX SECOND OPINION on the egress allowlist design (architecturally sensitive).

## 2f — supervisor (write_container_agent, THE lifecycle fix)
Mirror the resident KeepAlive two-phase sleep-loop from setup_host_pf (setup.sh:286-316): exponential backoff 5→30s until first success, then `while true; do sleep N; body || true; done` (StartInterval is dead on Tahoe). Supervisor runs `container system start` then re-asserts apiserver + agent container + socktainer + proxy, restarting any dead (the #158/#286/E4 gap). DOMAIN DECISION: apiserver #158 is a per-user gui LaunchAgent, so the supervisor likely must run gui-domain (like write_agent/write_model_agent → `gui/$(id -u)`, launchd.sh:19; needs a login session — host has one). write_agent (launchd.sh:26): label com.yclaw.tart-$node, RunAtLoad+KeepAlive. write_model_agent (setup.sh:70): adds EnvironmentVariables + ProcessType=Interactive + ExitTimeOut. host-pf-refresh is the one SYSTEM-domain LaunchDaemon (root, /Library/LaunchDaemons/, `id -u==0` gate).

## 2g — state: bind-mount ~/.yclaw/state/hermes into the container (restic file-level backup keeps working, E5; never a named volume).

## 2h — manifest + yclaw consumers
- KEEP the manifest key "hermes", the tailnet hostname "hermes", AND the agent-vault vault name "hermes" → minimal blast radius (tailnet ACL tag:hermes, metal vaultName, host-pf/bluebubbles-pf resolve-by-hostname all unchanged). Renaming either identity touches 218+ sites; keeping them touches ~3.
- machines.json hermes block (76-90): set managed_by:"container" (DEAD WEIGHT — parsed manifest.py:92 but never branched on, safe), tart_vm→null (only 2 consumers in remote.py, already short-circuited by admin_pass_keychain:null). Services map keys probes.
- yclaw probes (status.py/doctor.py) are manifest-driven + transport-agnostic IF: (a) container runs systemd inside (for systemd_state probes) OR add a health-kind Service probe; (b) container exposes sshd over tailscale for remote.run. OPEN Q: does `tailscale ssh` INTO a userspace-networking container work? If not → bigger remote.py change. doctor.py hermes-specific checks (doctor.py:59-79 `sudo -u hermes`, `hermes doctor` binary, `.hermes/.env`) + onboard/gates.py:305 assume a Linux `hermes` user+home INSIDE the guest — container internal user model must mirror this OR rework.
- 3 load-bearing python lookups: gates.py:305 manifest.machines["hermes"], doctor.py:91/98 by_name["hermes"].

## Phase 4c teardown surface (from u2-manifest)
destroy.sh:13 (bootout com.yclaw.tart-hermes in `for node in metal hermes bluebubbles`), destroy.sh:21 (`tart stop/delete hermes`), setup.sh:465-471 (`write_agent hermes ...` — the registration), bootstrap.sh:309-312 (hardcoded com.yclaw.tart-hermes bootstrap), machines.json:135-141 (host.services.tart-hermes, write-only doc — safe to remove). Retire scripts: deploy-vm.sh, build-hermes-image.sh, remint-hermes-authkey.sh (tart-only, no container equivalent). redeploy.sh:34/49-80 redeploy_hermes (nixos-rebuild path) → replace with container redeploy.

## OPEN design questions to resolve before/during build
1. Egress-deny pf allowlist for tailscale-only (codex 2nd opinion).
2. tailscale-ssh into a userspace-networking container — works for yclaw probes? (empirical, test Phase 2/3).
3. Supervisor domain: gui (apiserver #158 is gui) vs system.
4. Container internal user/home model to satisfy doctor.py `sudo -u hermes` + `.hermes/.env` checks + systemd-inside (for systemd_state probes) vs health-endpoint probes.
5. How the container joins the tailnet as "hermes" with tag:hermes (userspace tailscaled, TS_STATE_DIR bind-mounted for identity persistence; on a temporary identity during Phase 3 parallel-run since tag:hermes serves from one node).
ops.when: implementing Phase 2 of the hermes → Apple container migration
